manual.title: Deliver the prepared hip assembly
manual.goal: Lock the waist straight, crane the hip assembly onto the gantry and close its jaws.

note.text: At the UPPER LEAVES panel beside the left lift, close the workshop-side leaves, take the left lift to ROPE ACCESS and descend to the lifting eyes. Land, unclip and recall the rope before moving the crane.

manual.title: Seat the leg in the hip assembly
manual.goal: Bring the finished leg to the Final Assembly Bay, open the lower front, raise the leg into the left hip, then close the front.

note.text: Park the empty crane first. Find the foot support at the foot end of the rig, the transfer table lever in front of the table, the bogie box beside the table, and the LOWER FRONT panel beside the left lift. Each control moves one thing; the lamps say what is still needed. Keep the leg clamps closed until hip retention and both cylinder lock pins are fitted.

manual.title: Release the leg rig
manual.goal: Let the hip carry the leg, then drive the empty rigs home.

note.text: At the bogie box beside the table, hold LOWER until the empty holder lies flat, then TO TABLE. Move the table lever to RIGHT HIP · BUILD and tap GRAB on the leg clamps switch on the bogie to extend the empty clamps. Bring the foot rig home before using NEXT LEG.

manual.title: Reacquire support and recover
manual.body: If the empty leg rig has returned home, tap RELEASE on the leg clamps switch on the bogie while it is on the table to fold the empty clamps for travel. Pull the transfer table lever to this leg's hip notch, then use the bogie box to hold TO BAY and RISE to bring the empty rig upright under the mounted leg. Tap GRAB on the clamps switch to take the leg's weight. If the released rig is still upright under the leg, use GRAB directly. Wait for the clamps to finish gripping before any retention undo. Z removes the most recent bolt, washer and half in reverse order. Each half returns to your hands at the actual connection; store it on the lift shelf and ride to Ground. Remove every fitted retention piece and both cylinder lock pins, open the lower front at the LOWER FRONT panel beside the left lift, then hold LOWER at the bogie box to unseat the leg and lay it flat. Hold TO TABLE, then pull the table lever to RIGHT HIP · BUILD; push the foot support under the foot for construction. Use the lever's PARK notch to park the leg with the foot support away. The same physical components can be installed again. Never remove retention while the leg rig is released.

manual.title: Prepared chest and cockpit
manual.body: The chest frame, enclosed cockpit, fixed shoulder cups and neck spoke are supplied assembled. Use Chest to Heavy Module Bay at the shared crane to transfer it from the chest rig after selecting chest inserts on the empty heavy module rig. Keep the fitted cockpit upright. After checking the supported unit, lower the heavy module rig to its pickup stop and choose Chest to waist. The hip assembly manual owns seating, retention and service connections.

manual.title: Prepared core cartridge
manual.body: The core cartridge, keyed rails and four captive retaining bolts are supplied. Keep it horizontal on the heavy module rig's core saddles. Its forward magnetic connector captures two side pads; the aft magnetic connector attaches to the rear pad. The chest manual owns guide insertion, retention and rear connection.

manual.title: Prepared open backpack
manual.body: The backpack frame, rear cover, nozzles, hinge eyes, telescopic struts and lower latches are supplied together. Fit backpack perimeter inserts on the empty heavy module rig, then use Backpack to Heavy Module Bay to collect this same unit from its rig. Its front face rests downward, in the fully open installation orientation. Two structural lifting pads carry it with the shared spreader.

manual.title: Arm rig
manual.body: Park the leg rig using the transfer table lever's PARK notch before bringing the arm rig into the Limb Bay. The arm rig holds the prepared arm on three saddles and six clamps. Use the shared crane's Arm rig to Limb Bay task, fit all four magnetic connectors, then raise and transfer the retained arm rig. Its floor locks engage before the crane releases. Reverse the same task to park an unfinished arm without changing its construction.

manual.title: Prepared left arm

manual.title: Prepared right arm
manual.body: The upper arm, restrained elbow, forearm, neutral wrist and retained hand are supplied together. The arm rig supports three structural pads; four structural lifting faces carry the arm. Shoulder retention, drives, services and pauldron work belong to the chest manual.

manual.title: Prepared foot, empty leg rail
manual.body: The complete 135-piece foot is supplied on its rig. The leg rig and hip assembly connections are empty. Build the leg here, then open the hip assembly manual for rail travel, seating and retention. Knee and ankle transport braces are equipment, not loose parts.

manual.title: Deliver the foot
manual.goal: Crane the finished foot from its turning rig onto the foot rig.

manual.title: Dock the prepared foot
manual.goal: Hand the foot from the foot rig to the leg rig.

note.text: The leg rig must be home in the Limb Bay with neutral roll.

manual.goal: Crane LG-100 from its rig onto the foot adapter.

note.text: Keep both connectors attached until this connection is bolted.

manual.title: Secure the ankle flange
manual.goal: Bolt the shin flange, engage both ankle braces, then release and park the crane.

note.text: Insert the bolts from the knee side, toward the foot.

manual.title: Connect the shin disconnect
manual.goal: Plug the shin harness into the foot socket and the shin.

note.text: Approach from the side away from the part rigs, standing back toward the knee.

manual.goal: Fit both knee bearings, then a thrust spacer at each end of the knee boss.

note.text: Keep the marked knee axle aisle clear.

manual.goal: Crane LG-110 from its rig onto the shin knee boss and thrust spacers.

note.text: Keep both connectors attached until this connection is bolted.

note.text: Insert from the right leg's outward (+X) axle aisle. The cap and its screws fit on the inner side.

manual.goal: Cap the axle, engage both knee braces, then release and park the crane.

note.text: Work from the side opposite the axle aisle.

manual.goal: Crane LG-120 from its rig onto the fork flange.

note.text: Keep both connectors attached until this connection is bolted.

manual.title: Fasten the Upper-leg beam flange
manual.goal: Bolt the beam flange, engage both flange braces, then release and park the crane.

note.text: Insert the bolts from the hip side, toward the knee. These are M24 × 100, not the hip assembly M24 × 140.

manual.title: Structural leg ready
manual.body: All leg construction is complete. Park the empty crane with both magnetic connectors stowed. To park an unfinished leg without losing progress, pull its foot support away, then move the transfer table lever in front of the table to its PARK notch. For rear work at RIGHT HIP · BUILD, keep the foot support under the foot and the transport braces locked, and park the movable platform. At the turnover box at the head end of the table, hold RAISE fully, then hold ROLL in either direction; each fresh press turns to the next 90° stop. ROLL back to neutral, then hold LOWER to return to construction height. Open the hip assembly manual for delivery.

manual.title: Supported construction recovery
manual.body: Bring the supported leg to RIGHT HIP · BUILD before construction disassembly. Use the turnover box at the head end of the table for rear access: with the foot support under the foot and braces locked, hold RAISE, then ROLL to each 90° stop. ROLL back to neutral, then LOWER before moving the table. To park the supported leg, pull the foot support away and move the table lever to its PARK notch. Select the affected crane task, lower at the leg rig and attach both magnetic connectors to take the weight before Z removes its retaining hardware. Reverse each task: remove all flange pairs before lifting shin or beam; remove cap screws, washers, cap and axle before lifting the fork. Raise crane withdraws the supported part through the reverse axial approach; Put back and Lower crane returns it. Detach and stow only after it is seated on its rig. Undo FA-605 before shin removal. With all structural work removed and the leg rig home, use the foot rig to take the foot back and lower it to dispatch.

manual.title: Foot workshop
manual.body: Build both heel pads and the pitch actuator, then fit them to the foot.

manual.title: Cradle clevis
manual.goal: Bolt the cradle clevis to FA-103.

manual.title: Ring clevis
manual.goal: Bolt the ring clevis to FA-200.

manual.title: Seat & pin actuator
manual.goal: Seat the prepared actuator between the clevises and pin both ends.

manual.title: Prepare
manual.goal: Hang FA-302 (heel pad) at a preparation station and fit its four sleeves.

manual.title: Bring together
manual.body: Carry the prepared heel pad to an empty heel position on the foot.

manual.title: Drive cartridge
manual.goal: Put FA-513 (motor) in the preparation C fixture and mount the gearbox on it.

manual.title: Coupling & bearing
manual.goal: Fit the coupling on the gearbox shaft and position the bearing.

note.text: Leave FA-515 unclamped for now.

manual.title: Lead screw
manual.goal: Slide the lead screw into the bearing and clamp the coupling.

manual.title: Retain the shaft
manual.goal: Lock the lead screw in place with the retainer and collar.

manual.title: Travelling nut
manual.goal: Thread the travelling nut onto the lead screw.

manual.title: Output rod
manual.goal: Join the output rod to the travelling nut.

manual.title: Enclose the drive
manual.goal: Close the housing around the drive and bolt it to the motor and retainer.

manual.title: Guide key
manual.goal: Fit the guide key so the rod slides without turning.

manual.title: End sensors
manual.goal: Fit both end-stop probes and the barrel plug.

manual.title: Front guide & seals
manual.goal: Fit the front guide, the wiper and both cap gaskets.

note.text: The gasket with extra clearance holes goes at the motor end.

manual.title: Close the housing
manual.goal: Fit both end caps and bolt them shut.

manual.title: Base eye
manual.goal: Build the base eye: housing, bearing, then retaining ring.

manual.title: Rod eye
manual.goal: Build the rod eye: housing, bearing, then retaining ring.

manual.title: Ready to install
manual.body: FA-500-P is ready. Seat it in the foot.

manual.title: Prepared foot, empty leg rail
manual.body: The complete 135-piece foot is supplied on its rig. The leg rig and hip assembly connections are empty. Build the leg here, then open the hip assembly manual for rail travel, seating and retention. Knee and ankle transport braces are equipment, not loose parts.

manual.title: Deliver the foot
manual.goal: Crane the finished foot from its turning rig onto the foot rig.

manual.title: Dock the prepared foot
manual.goal: Hand the foot from the foot rig to the leg rig.

note.text: The leg rig must be home in the Limb Bay with neutral roll.

manual.title: Deliver the structural shin
manual.goal: Crane LG-100 from its rig onto the foot adapter.

note.text: Keep both connectors attached until this connection is bolted.

manual.title: Secure the ankle flange
manual.goal: Bolt the shin flange, engage both ankle braces, then release and park the crane.

note.text: Insert the bolts from the knee side, toward the foot.

manual.title: Connect the shin disconnect
manual.goal: Plug the shin harness into the foot socket and the shin.

note.text: Approach from the side away from the part rigs, standing back toward the knee.

manual.title: Seat bearings and thrust spacers
manual.goal: Fit both knee bearings, then a thrust spacer at each end of the knee boss.

note.text: Keep the marked knee axle aisle clear.

manual.title: Deliver the knee fork
manual.goal: Crane LG-110 from its rig onto the shin knee boss and thrust spacers.

note.text: Keep both connectors attached until this connection is bolted.

manual.title: Insert the knee axle
manual.goal: Slide the knee axle through the fork and bearings.

note.text: Carry it lengthwise with both hands from the marked axle aisle.

manual.title: Retain the knee axle
manual.goal: Cap the axle, engage both knee braces, then release and park the crane.

note.text: Work from the side opposite the axle aisle.

manual.title: Deliver the Upper-leg beam
manual.goal: Crane LG-120 from its rig onto the fork flange.

note.text: Keep both connectors attached until this connection is bolted.

manual.title: Fasten the Upper-leg beam flange
manual.goal: Bolt the beam flange, engage both flange braces, then release and park the crane.

note.text: Insert the bolts from the hip side, toward the knee. These are M24 × 100, not the hip assembly M24 × 140.

manual.title: Structural leg ready
manual.body: All leg construction is complete. Park the empty crane with both magnetic connectors stowed. To park an unfinished leg without losing progress, pull its foot support away, then move the transfer table lever in front of the table to its PARK notch. For rear work at RIGHT HIP · BUILD, keep the foot support under the foot and the transport braces locked, and park the movable platform. At the turnover box at the head end of the table, hold RAISE fully, then hold ROLL in either direction; each fresh press turns to the next 90° stop. ROLL back to neutral, then hold LOWER to return to construction height. Open the hip assembly manual for delivery.

manual.title: Supported construction recovery
manual.body: Bring the supported leg to RIGHT HIP · BUILD before construction disassembly. Use the turnover box at the head end of the table for rear access: with the foot support under the foot and braces locked, hold RAISE, then ROLL to each 90° stop. ROLL back to neutral, then LOWER before moving the table. To park the supported leg, pull the foot support away and move the table lever to its PARK notch. Select the affected crane task, lower at the leg rig and attach both magnetic connectors to take the weight before Z removes its retaining hardware. Reverse each task: remove all flange pairs before lifting shin or beam; remove cap screws, washers, cap and axle before lifting the fork. Raise crane withdraws the supported part through the reverse axial approach; Put back and Lower crane returns it. Detach and stow only after it is seated on its rig. Undo FA-605 before shin removal. With all structural work removed and the leg rig home, use the foot rig to take the foot back and lower it to dispatch.
